notes.title: Official Release Date - May 23rd
notes.content:
Wacky Cartoon Racers will be released May 23rd!

We've added the Skeleton King, Fairy Forests, Castles and other fun areas.


New trailer and screenshots will be posted closer to the release.

notes.title: Wacky Cartoon Racers - Price Change
notes.content:
Thankyou for your interest in Wacky Cartoon Racers.

The software we are using is having issues (it's their fault, not ours), so we will not be able to make multiplayer or other planned features we had hoped for in this game.  It's been almost 2 years, so we are deciding to move on from this specific and unnamed software.

[b]As compensation, we feel it is only fair we drop the price of this game from the original $10 down to a low 99 cents.[/b]

Wacky Cartoon Racers will be released in 2021, and a future remake is planned in 3D, with multiplayer and much improved options.  


Thankyou

notes.title: Demo coming June 15th!
notes.content: Wacky Cartoons Racers free demo and trailer will be released June 15th!

notes.title: Release Date Pushed Back
notes.content:
Hey gamers!  The release date for this game has been pushed back a few weeks.

We want to make sure you enjoy this game, so we're adding additional content like voice overs and extra characters for the release.  

Feel free to post in the forums with any feedback/comments!
